description: Add champion performance stats, role distribution chart, and performance trends chart using recharts
steps: Install recharts: run 'bun add recharts' in /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-league-tracker. Recharts is a lightweight React charting library that works well with React 19.

Create app/components/ChampionStats.tsx: Aggregate match data to show per-champion stats. For each unique champion in the matches array, compute: games played, win rate (%), average KDA, average CS/min. Display as a responsive table/card grid sorted by games played. Include the champion icon using next/image. Show at least the top 5-8 most played champions.

Create app/components/RoleDistribution.tsx: A donut/pie chart showing the distribution of roles played. Since the current MatchSummary type does not include role data, derive roles from queueType and champion data patterns OR add a note that role data requires API enhancement. For now, show a distribution based on game modes (Ranked Solo, Ranked Flex, ARAM, Normal, etc.) as a proxy. Use recharts PieChart with ResponsiveContainer.

Create app/components/PerformanceTrends.tsx: A line chart showing KDA and win rate trends over the loaded matches (up to 20 games). X-axis is match index (most recent first). Y-axis for KDA (line) and win rate (rolling average over last 5 games as a second line). Use recharts LineChart with ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, and Legend. Support dark mode colors.
Update lib/types.ts if needed for any new interfaces (ChampionStatsSummary, etc.).

Create app/components/AnalyticsSection.tsx: A wrapper component that renders ChampionStats, RoleDistribution, and PerformanceTrends in a responsive grid layout. Include section headings and only render when matches are available.
Update app/components/Dashboard.tsx: Add AnalyticsSection below the summoner info and above MatchHistory (or in a tabbed view). Only show when matches are loaded. Pass the full matches array to it.
Verify the build passes with 'bunx next build' and lint passes with 'bunx eslint .'
acceptance_criteria: Champion performance table shows win rate, average KDA, and CS/min per champion with champion icons
Role/game mode distribution renders as a donut chart with labels and percentages
Performance trends line chart shows KDA trend across loaded matches
All charts are responsive and render correctly in both light and dark mode
Charts use recharts library with proper ResponsiveContainer wrappers
verification: Run 'bunx eslint .' and confirm zero errors
Run 'bunx next build' and confirm successful build with no TypeScript or compilation errors
findings: Recharts 3.9.2 installed successfully. PieLabelRenderProps does not include custom data fields (like 'percentage') - use payload cast instead. Tooltip formatter should not explicitly type params to avoid ValueType incompatibility. worker_threads warnings from Bun are cosmetic and do not affect the build.
